title: Tree Sections Prop Only API
description: Refactor elements Tree so section nodes are only provided through the sections prop, TreeSection components cannot be nested inside each other, and only item nodes can be nested. Update downstream consumers in sketchpad, coda, and stories/tests to the new contract and verify with targeted tests.
summary: Removed the remaining TreeSection child-component API from Tree so consumers now pass only sections data via props. Added TreeDataSection content and pointer hooks for arbitrary section body content, migrated elements internal consumers plus sketchpad/coda/stories to sections arrays, and re-verified with elements vitest, package type-checks, sketchpad build, and coda renderer build.
